page.notes: The initial A is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "Ntè", read as "ANtè". The last word is cut off by the edge of the scan and could not be read. The right-hand page edge shows fragments only and is not transcribed. The top line "quæritur." is cut off from the previous line, so it stays a fragment. The word "quatenus" is printed across a line end ("quate" / "nus.") without a visible hyphen, so it is written whole. The word "sit" in line 16 is read as "sit" and is not fully certain. The large PRÆ at the lower right is taken as a catchword, but its nature is uncertain. The faint "E 2" at the foot may be show-through, so it is marked [?]. The faint text in the lower middle of the page is show-through and has been left out. The strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and has been left out.
